release_notes: **Option Scanner multi-expiry**: the Flow tab gains an **IV term** tile (ATM IV and 1σ move for the next 4 expiries, flagged when the front expiry's IV is above the next) and a **Next futures** tile with the combined near + next OI change and a **Roll** label when the two OI changes are roughly equal and opposite. **Snapshot recorder records 4 expiries**: the nearest two at ATM ±15 strikes, the next two at ±3, plus near- and next-month futures, in one batched quote. Later expiries store only their ATM IV and 1σ move. Needs a full rebuild to take effect on the installed app.
